plan.title: Mandatory terms block partial vendor acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as a price-based reverse auction awarding the entire lot.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the first line item's delivery location.

args.goal: On the single-stage create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" so both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and stop on the create screen.

steps.note: Perform the clause creation and mandatory override that no catalog domain step can express.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the published auction's vendor bid sheet and terms.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Attempt to submit the quote after accepting only one mandatory clause; the vendor submission must be blocked.
